title: Koh Lanta spas
sub: Proper spa treatments on Lanta, from jungle resort spa to the best-rated local massage. Tick the ones you've done.
tip: Lanta has no big standalone day-spa complex, so the top end is resort spas that take outside guests: ring ahead. Faikham and Taaya get booked up, message them a day before. Prices at ~฿37.5 to €1.

places.name: Pimalai Spa
notes: The big one: spa village in the jungle with a waterfall running through it
Price: no menu online, expect roughly €35–70 per massage +17% tax/service, ring to check
Packages are the move, makes a proper half day
Resort spa, ring to book as a non-guest (+66 75 607 999)

places.name: Taaya Spa
notes: Rated 5.0 from 500+ reviews, standalone spa with proper packages
Price: around €33 each for a 90-min package (฿2,500 for two)
Scrub + massage + facial combos, great value vs resort spas

places.name: Layana Spa
notes: Adults-only beachfront resort, spa gets loads of love in reviews
Price: no menu online, expect roughly €35–70 per massage +17% tax/service
Right next to Taaya, so easy to compare
Ring ahead as an outside guest (+66 75 607 100)

places.name: Faikham Lanta Thai Massage
notes: Not a spa day, but the best-rated massage on the island (1,200+ reviews)
Price: local-shop rates, roughly €5–8 for an hour of Thai massage

places.name: Rawi Warin Spa
notes: Big resort with its own spa, lush gardens
Price: no menu online, resort-spa rates, roughly €35–70
Handy if you're down the Klong Nin end, ring first
